sentences.en: Cheating on one's spouse is not usually considered acceptable behavior.
sentences.zh: 对配偶不忠通常被认为不可接受的行为。

sentences.en: Do you think your spouse spends enough time with you?
sentences.zh: 你认为你的配偶花足够多的时间陪你吗？

sentences.en: Until my coffin closes I will be your faithful spouse.
sentences.zh: 直到我的棺材盖上，我都会是你忠诚的伴侣。
